description: freeway trajectory datasets_consider change_lane_intention is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Xiangzun Bu. Considering the influence of lane changing intention on vehicle trajectory, in order to verify whether considering lane changing intention in the trajectory prediction process can improve the prediction accuracy, the NGSIM dataset and HighD dataset are used for verification. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
